summary: Carlyle Credit Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K covering items 3.02, 7.01, and 8.01. Under Item 3.02, it reported the issuance and sale of 2,074,963 shares of Class I common stock for aggregate consideration of $38.2 million on April 1, 2026, with the final number determined on April 24, 2026. The issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. Under Item 7.01, the board declared a $0.16 per share dividend payable May 27, 2026. Under Item 8.01, it disclosed a March 31, 2026 NAV per share of $18.39 and aggregate NAV of ~$1.8 billion. This is a routine continuous offering disclosure, not a special situation.
